context_findings.note: The conception establishes the platform's purpose: enabling educators to organize materials and prepare lessons based on verifiable sources, with human review before publication. This sets the domain and core functionality.
context_findings.subject: purpose
context_findings.text: Uma plataforma para educadores organizarem materiais e prepararem aulas baseadas em fontes, com revisão humana antes da publicação.

context_findings.note: The branding specifies the target audience (educators and pedagogical coordinators) and tone (clear, welcoming, precise), emphasizing usability and trust. The principles highlight verifiability and educator control, which are foundational to the domain.
context_findings.subject: audience
context_findings.text: educadores, coordenadores pedagógicos, claro, acolhedor, preciso, fontes verificáveis, controle do educador

context_findings.note: Technical constraints specify Python 3.12+, versioned contracts, and no exposure of personal data in traces. The business constraint of human review before publication is explicitly stated, reinforcing content governance.
context_findings.subject: domain
context_findings.text: Python 3.12 ou superior, contratos versionados, não expor dados pessoais em traces, revisão humana antes de publicação

context_findings.note: Backlog descriptions and acceptance criteria define core user flows: cataloging materials and preparing lesson drafts. The acceptance criteria are directly aligned with the criteria list, indicating consistency.
context_findings.subject: capability
context_findings.text: Permitir que o educador catalogue materiais e suas fontes, Preparar um rascunho de aula usando os materiais selecionados, Cada material tem título, autor e referência de origem, Materiais só são visíveis ao educador responsável, As afirmações do rascunho referenciam os materiais utilizados, A publicação exige revisão e aprovação do educador

criteria.condition: Each material must have a title, author, and source reference.
criteria.note: The requirement is directly stated in the acceptance criterion and aligns with the conception of the platform. No ambiguity or conflict is detected.
criteria.outcome: Ensures traceability and verifiability of educational content, supporting the principle of 'fontes verificáveis'.

criteria.condition: Materials are visible only to the responsible educator.
criteria.note: The visibility restriction is explicitly defined in the acceptance criterion and matches the branding principle of 'controle do educador'.
criteria.outcome: Maintains ownership and privacy of educational materials, consistent with educator control and interface accessibility.

criteria.condition: Lesson draft assertions must reference the materials used in the preparation.
criteria.note: The requirement that assertions in lesson drafts reference used materials is present in the acceptance criterion and supports content integrity.
criteria.outcome: Ensures that lesson content is grounded in sourced materials, promoting accuracy and traceability.

criteria.condition: Publication requires review and approval by the educator.
criteria.note: The publication requirement for educator review and approval is clearly stated in the acceptance criterion and aligns with the business constraint of human review before publication.
criteria.outcome: Enforces quality control and accountability in content dissemination.
